turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Let's pivot to refraction. Why does a pencil look bent when dipped in water?

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_2
turn_boundaries.text: Because light changes its speed as it leaves water and enters air! That speed change makes the ray bend at the surface boundary.

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Right! And Snell's Law quantifies that bending. The higher the refractive index n, the slower light travels in that medium.
